# Daniel Wijaya

> Daniel Wijaya is a frontend engineer who bridges design and development to build user-centered digital products.

This site contains information about Daniel's background, experience, skills, projects, and products.

- [About](https://danielwijaya.com/about): Biography, experience, skills, clients, and tools.
- [Case Studies](https://danielwijaya.com/case-study): Project case studies and details.
- [Builds](https://danielwijaya.com/builds): Products and themes built by Daniel.
- [Contact](https://danielwijaya.com/contact): Contact information and form.
